Graduate Admissions
Admissions to University of Arizona Materials Science and Engineering graduate programs are handled through the UA Graduate College. Information provided here is summarized. Please see the Graduate College pages specified below and the MSE Graduate Student Handbook (PDF) for detailed information.
Apply Now
Interested in a snapshot of the UA MSE grad programs? Check out this one-page flyer:
Materials Science and Engineering Graduate Programs (PDF)
Graduate Certificates (PDF)
Semiconductor Manufacturing Minor (PDF) and Curriculum (PDF)
Submission Reminders
Remember the following with your application as a decision cannot be entered until all requirements are met and all materials are received:
Official transcript, ensuring if you are from India that it includes official sum of total marks and marks obtained for each semester
Minimum GPA 3.0
Competitive GRE general test score
GRE Institution Code for the University of Arizona – 4832
For international students who do not hold degrees from English-speaking universities, TOEFL or IELTS scores dated no more than two years before the term of application
TOEFL minimum score of 79 for the Internet exam and 550 for the paper exam
IELTS composite score of at least 7 with no subject area falling below 6
Resume, including a list of any published papers
One-page summary of research interests and career objectives
Three letters of recommendation, with at least one from faculty of doctoral applicant’s MS program
Application Deadlines
Fall: Jan. 15
Spring: June 1
